name: Nabeel NH
review: Doctors are very polite and kind. Charges are very economical and there are multiple visits where they didn't charge me for small consultations. Doctors are very thorough and don't recommend procedures unnecessarily. Overall very satisfied and would highly recommend this hospital for any dental consultation / procedure. Keep it up

review: Doctors provide right advice and are experienced. Charge is economical compared to big chains. Have done root canal and scaling. Highly recommended.

name: Kavipriya
review: Undoubtedly the best clinic in this part of the town. Excellent work ethics. Affordable and competitive pricing. Genuine one on one patient care and very clean. Heartfelt thanks to both the doctors.

name: A. Nagarethinam
review: Excellent doctor and good treatment. I had two teeth removed on yesterday night. But no swelling and no pain till now. Excellent approach.

name: Vasanthakumar
review: Good service, moderate charges, experienced doctors. We can give 5 star rating for this clinic. Dr. Ragunanthan is very experienced dentist, he doing service along with his wife, she also experienced dentist. I recommend all to go here for their dental problems.
